::: {.content-visible when-profile="course"}
::: {.callout-note title="Draft"}
The workshop length is decided after the content. These drafts fit the
lessons into four or five days of about six teaching hours. The times are
computed from the planned length of each part and will be tuned after a
first run. Participants do the [setup](pages/00-setup.qmd)
before day 1, including the cache prefetch, and run the
[lesson 03 download](pages/03-data-management.qmd#hands-on) on day 1 morning
while the introduction runs.
:::

<!-- The tables are built from schedules/workshop-4day.yml,
schedules/workshop-5day.yml and schedules/modules.yml; the day's start,
lunch and breaks come from event.yml. -->

::: {.panel-tabset}

The core lessons, with time for your own project every day and a

## Five days

All the in-class parts of the course, at a gentler pace, with time for
your own project every day and a show-and-tell at the end.

{{< schedule workshop-5day >}}
